method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 威士忌喝完后 Hattie 明知是错仍倒了葡萄酒。
facts.anchor: When the whiskey’s gone she pours some wine, knowing it’s a mistake but doing it anyway.

facts.fact: Hattie 请求第二天来看 Julian，Wendy 说可以，只要 Julian 状态允许。
facts.anchor: She’d asked to come by the next day to see Julian, and Wendy said that would be fine.

facts.fact: Hattie 想起过去去监狱探望 Tommy 前也会有这种反胃的感觉。
facts.anchor: She used to feel like this when getting ready to visit Tommy in prison.

facts.fact: Hattie 回忆 Tommy 小时候 Ed 为他做跷跷板，还雕刻定制座椅、做可调支点以补偿他体重轻。
facts.anchor: Ed had gone all out carving custom seats and an adjustable tipping point so Tommy’s lighter weight would be more offset by the leverage.

facts.fact: Hattie 脑中反复权衡：Julian 是自卫，被刺的是 Bastion 两刀，他曾被半淹——他不是 Tommy，而是 Tommy 的儿子。
Hattie 承认 Eeling 说得对——她一直在监视 Julian，想从他身上找回在 Tommy 那里错失的东西。
facts.anchor: Eeling was right—she’s been watching Julian. Watching for what she missed in Tommy.

facts.fact: Hattie 想起 Wendy 的话：要是知道他的父母、知道这种事是否家族遗传，就更容易诊断和治疗。
facts.anchor: I wish I knew his parents—if this kind of thing runs in the family, it would be easier to diagnose and treat.

facts.fact: Hattie 担心 Eeling 会把今天小学的刺人事件写进书里：“连环杀手之子刺伤同学：追随 Bedfellow 的脚步。”
facts.anchor: Son of serial killer stabs fellow student: following in the Bedfellow’s footsteps.

facts.fact: Hattie 披上厚毛衣、抓起钥匙开车出去，要确认 Eeling 是否已走，并低声说“我们会达成谅解”。
facts.anchor: Before she can change course she’s shrugged on the heavy sweater and grabbed her keys.
